source: NAR NXT board meeting, Nov. 2026, via HousingWire

headline: Realtor ranks
*barely shrink*
slides.fig_caption: Change in NAR membership from a year earlier
slides.sub: Far fewer agents left than NAR had budgeted for.

slides.label: NAR members as of *late September*
slides.body: The exact count is 1,469,127, which is 22% above the 1.2 million members NAR budgeted for. Its treasurer says 2027 renewals are tracking in line with 2026.

slides.title: What the board *approved*
points: About $13.7M set for the consumer ad campaign
MLSs get more ways to claim listing copyright
More local control over feeds and data use

slides.title: The field is *still crowded*
slides.body: Nearly 1.5 million Realtors are working a slower market, and the rules around listing data are shifting. Steady follow-up with every past client and lead is what sets you apart.
